glide.note: walk speed (4 tiles/s): advance 16 px per frame

idle.note: same art as glide without wake

mount.note: f0-2 skiff surfaces in front of the player (splash ring); f3 rider hop (hip 6 px up); f4-5 seated, settle bob. Play facing the water tile; tween the player 1 tile into it over f3-f4

dismount.note: rider hop onto land (tween 1 tile), skiff dives (sinks under the waterline); then walk frames
